prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1407; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked and displaced, tail lamp assembly broken on the driver side, and trunk lid edge deformed with the panel seam showing stress. Damage pattern is largely consistent with the impact described by the insured. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and lamp assembly, straightening the trunk lid flange, and refinishing the affected panels. Labor hours submitted fit the scope of the damage. Shop invoices show no repeated charges for the same operations. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record. Recommend approval of the repair as written.
